description: Missed medication multi-turn test scenarios - v2. Same 20 scenarios as v1, but the single-turn DID_TAKE (scenario_07) and refusal (scenario_15) scenarios gain a confirming second turn to fit the two-turn follow-up structure (assistant delivers its follow-up/standard message, then finalizes on the senior reply). The single-turn WILL_TAKE scenarios (10, 12) are left as-is because a clear commitment is correctly finalized in one turn.

scenarios.name: Senior already took medication
scenarios.description: Senior clearly states they already took their medication - sensor simply missed it. Assistant should deliver the clarification message, then return DID_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Yes, I already took it this morning
Yes I'm sure, I took it from the box with my breakfast

scenarios.name: Senior forgot but will take it now
scenarios.description: Senior acknowledges they have not taken it yet and commits to taking it right away. Assistant should deliver Reminder #2, then return DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Oh no, I completely forgot about it
You're right, I'll go take it now

scenarios.name: Senior refuses to take medication
scenarios.description: Senior explicitly refuses to take their medication. Assistant should deliver Message #2, then return DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE.

user_turns.text: No, I don't want to take it
I already told you, I won't take it today

scenarios.name: Senior does not respond (silence)
scenarios.description: Senior gives no response across multiple turns. The situation cannot be resolved in conversation, so the assistant should deliver the soft message and return COULD_NOT_VALIDATE.

scenarios.name: Senior took it with breakfast
scenarios.description: Senior took the medication with their breakfast.

user_turns.text: I took it with my breakfast this morning
Yes, I'm certain I took it

scenarios.name: Senior confirms pills are done
scenarios.description: Senior states plainly they already took their pills.

user_turns.text: Already took my pills, thank you dear
Yes, all done

scenarios.name: Senior took it an hour ago
scenarios.description: Senior took the medication earlier and clearly says so; after the assistant asks them to confirm it came from the box, they confirm. Assistant returns DID_TAKE.

user_turns.text: I had it about an hour ago, everything is fine
Yes, I'm sure — I took it from the box this morning

scenarios.name: DID_TAKE with ASR misrecognition
scenarios.description: Speech recognition mishears 'medication' as 'dedication'; assistant should read it in context as the senior confirming they took it.

user_turns.text: I already took my dedication today
That's right, I book it every morning

scenarios.name: Senior will take it right away
scenarios.description: Senior has not taken it and commits to doing so immediately.

user_turns.text: Not yet, but I'll take it right away
Going to get it now

scenarios.name: Senior forgot and takes it now
scenarios.description: Senior forgot and immediately agrees to take it.

user_turns.text: Oh, I forgot! Let me take it now

scenarios.name: Senior goes to get it
scenarios.description: Senior has not taken it and says they will fetch it this minute.

user_turns.text: Haven't taken it yet
I'll go get it this minute

scenarios.name: Senior was about to take it
scenarios.description: Senior was about to take it and commits to doing it now.

user_turns.text: I was just about to. I'll do it now

scenarios.name: Senior declines flatly
scenarios.description: Senior refuses and confirms the refusal.

user_turns.text: No, I'm not going to take it
Yes, I'm sure. No.

scenarios.name: Senior refuses over how it feels
scenarios.description: Senior refuses because it makes them feel sick and holds firm.

user_turns.text: I won't take it, it makes me feel sick
No, my decision is final

scenarios.name: Senior refuses for today
scenarios.description: Senior firmly declines for the day and, after the assistant delivers Message #2 asking them to reconsider, holds firm. Assistant returns DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Not today, absolutely not
No, I'm certain — I won't be taking it today

scenarios.name: Senior stopped taking it
scenarios.description: Senior says they stopped taking it and will not take it now.

user_turns.text: No, I stopped taking those a while ago
I won't be taking it

scenarios.name: Senior is confused about the topic
scenarios.description: Senior does not understand the question and stays confused after a clarifying attempt.

user_turns.text: What pills? I don't know what you mean
I'm confused, what is this about?

scenarios.name: Senior cannot remember
scenarios.description: Senior cannot recall whether they took it.

user_turns.text: I can't remember if I took it
My memory is bad, I really don't know

scenarios.name: Senior is upset and disengages
scenarios.description: Senior is upset and refuses to engage with the question.

user_turns.text: Stop asking me about my pills
Leave me alone please

scenarios.name: Senior is disoriented
scenarios.description: Senior is disoriented and cannot follow the conversation.

user_turns.text: Who is this again?
I don't understand, what were we saying?
